launch_delta: RESUME of the crashed E-int run, NOT a new experiment. Original trpo_eint_s30_260727_160913 (launched 16:09, human-approved under this same proposal) died at iteration ~2390/5000 at 19:30 from an Isaac Sim INTERNAL fault: carb.tasking/Mutex.cpp:103 assertion (m_recursive) 'Recursion not allowed' -> C++ abort. NOT a policy/learning failure: last logged iteration showed Mean reward 260.5, Term/terminated 0.0000, roll_err 0.78 deg / pitch_err 0.68 deg, thr/util_mean 0.1487, no NaN/OOM/CUDA error and no Python traceback. Last checkpoint model_2350.pt (19:24). Possible contributing factor recorded for the record: startup warnings 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is set ... can lead to undesired behavior or crashes' + RTX 4060 skipped as 'CUDA in bad state'; not proven causal. RESUME SEMANTICS verified in code before queuing: (a) ALBCConstraintEncoderRunner.load() restores doraemon_state.pt via _load_aux_state (constraint_encoder_runner.py:309-313), so the DORAEMON curriculum continues rather than resetting -- this is what keeps the pre-registered fault_severity check valid; (b) rsl_rl OnPolicyRunner.load() restores current_learning_iteration = loaded_dict['iter'] (on_policy_runner.py:325) and learn() computes tot_iter = start_iter + num_learning_iterations (line 97), THEREFORE --max_iterations must be 2650 (=5000-2350) so the run ends at 5000 and writes model_4999.pt, the exact checkpoint the pre-registered verdict rule names. Passing 5000 would run to 7350 and invalidate the comparison. (c) train.py:236 always mints a NEW run_id dir from the current timestamp, so the resume CANNOT append to the original dir -- hence a new tag. TAG eint_s30_rs2350 (not the bare eint_s30) for two reasons: two dirs sharing the tag would make agent.load_run regex ambiguous, and scripts/finalize_run_log.sh requires EXACTLY ONE dir matching *<name>_2* (it fails loud on 2 matches). Everything else IDENTICAL to the original: task Isaac-ConstrainedALBC-TRPO-v0, seed 30, 4096 envs, --fault (Arm A), --privileged-fault-obs ABSENT, group + wandb project teacher_baseline_buoyfix, GPU0. Knobs re-verified in the ORIGINAL run params/env.yaml: max_thrust_scale (0.85,1.15), fault.enable true, use_privileged_fault_obs false. VERDICT RULE UNCHANGED (pre-registered in next-20260727-155500, independent-reviewer FINAL APPROVE after 3 rounds); the resume does not touch it. One comparability caveat to carry into the report: the run is stitched across a process restart at iter 2350, so DORAEMON continues from restored state but the env RNG stream restarts -- a discontinuity absent from the anchor run.
